dz: 阿克西亚战役在密西西比州图佩洛现址附近出战. 英国和奇克萨斯士兵击退了法国和乔克塔克对当时的奇克萨斯村阿克克亚的攻击.

te: The Lebanese Council of 1736 begins, a major turning point in the reform of the Maronite Church. In the following three…
dz: 1736年的黎巴嫩理事会开始,这是马龙派教会改革中的一个重要转折点. 在随后的三天里,由优素福·伊本·西曼(Yusuf ibn Siman)为主席的马龙派和拉丁教神职人员聚集在一起,讨论各种改革并详细制定规则和教条.
de: The Lebanese Council of 1736 begins, a major turning point in the reform of the Maronite Church. In the following three days, the assembled Maronite and Latin clergy presided by Yusuf ibn Siman as-Simani discuss various reforms and elaborate rules and canons.
